metadata.name: Per-node escalation: one that asks, one with nobody to ask
metadata.description: Two work nodes on one edge: the first declares no escalation policy and falls into the default (on_uncertainty, the behaviour it always had), the second declares "never" and names a recipient. The smallest document that can tell a default from a declared policy (t167).
metadata.source: a manual port (t167's per-node escalation proof)

nodes.description: Writes the text. Declares no escalation policy: it asks when it stalls, as every node always asked.

checks.description: The note exists and is not empty.

nodes.description: Publishes what was drafted. Declares "never": there is nobody waiting on this stage, so stalling here is a failure of the node's contract, never a pending question.

checks.description: The record of the publication exists and is not empty.

edges.description: A single exit: the drafted text always goes on to publication.
